### 🚀 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you are proposing.

### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. *I'm always frustrated when...*

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this working in LuminaTales (e.g., UI changes, new API endpoint, additional TTS voice models, etc.).

### 🌟 Target Persona / Benefit
- **Who benefits:** [e.g., Children, Parents, Developers]
- **Why it matters:** Briefly explain the value this adds to the interactive storybook experience.

### 📌 Additional Context or Mockups
Add any design mockups, workflow sketches, or reference links here.
